{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794648552250,"sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"W76U60ovnCAp4pTi","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation\n\ndata = np.load(\"/app/tubes_cloud.npz\")\npts_a = data[\"pts_a\"]\npts_b = data[\"pts_b\"]\n\n# Downsample to 5mm for fast analysis first\ndef voxel_ds(pts, vs):\n    coords = np.floor(pts / vs).astype(np.int64)\n    _, idx = np.unique(coords, axis=0, return_index=True)\n    return pts[idx]\n\na5 = voxel_ds(pts_a, 0.005)\nb5 = voxel_ds(pts_b, 0.005)\nprint(f\"5mm clouds: a={len(a5)}, b={len(b5)}\")\n\n# Check initial clearance between tube_a and tube_b\ntree_a2 = cKDTree(pts_a)\ndists_ab, idx_a = tree_a2.query(pts_b, k=1, workers=-1)\nmin_idx = np.argmin(dists_ab)\nprint(f\"Initial min distance between tube_a and tube_b: {dists_ab[min_idx]*1000:.3f} mm\")\nprint(f\"  closest point on a: {pts_a[idx_a[min_idx]]}, on b: {pts_b[min_idx]}\")\n\n# Estimate surface normals on a5 and check tube radius via ray-casting / opposite-side thickness\ntree_a5 = cKDTree(a5)\n# Pick 500 random points on a5, fit local plane (PCA on k=30 neighbors)\nrng = np.random.default_rng(42)\nsample_idx = rng.choice(len(a5), size=2000, replace=False)\n_, nn_idx = tree_a5.query(a5[sample_idx], k=40)\nneighbors = a5[nn_idx] # (2000, 40, 3)\ncentered = neighbors - neighbors.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)\ncov = np.einsum(\"nki,nkj->nij\", centered, centered) / 40.0\neigvals, eigvecs = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\nnormals = eigvecs[:, :, 0] # smallest eigenvalue\n\n# For a circular tube of radius R, pts - R * inward_normal (or + R * normal) collapses onto a 1D curve!\n# Let's test candidate radii R in [0.01, 0.15] by measuring local dimensionality / density after shifting along +/- normal!\n# Even simpler: for each sample point p with unit normal n, look for points q near the line p + t*n (t != 0)\nradii_est = []\nfor p, n in zip(a5[sample_idx[:500]], normals[:500]):\n    # query points within 0.20m\n    idxs = tree_a5.query_ball_point(p, 0.20)\n     diff = a5[idxs] - p\n    proj = diff @ n\n    perp = np.linalg.norm(diff - np.outer(proj, n), axis=1)\n    # opposite side of tube has perp < 0.008 and |proj| > 0.015\n    opp = np.abs(proj[(perp < 0.006) & (np.abs(proj) > 0.015)])\n    if len(opp) > 0:\n        radii_est.append(np.min(opp) / 2.0)\n\nradii_est = np.array(radii_est)\nprint(\"Estimated tube radius quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(radii_est * 1000, [0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95]))\n\n# Find rigid transform from tube_a to tube_b using PCA initialization (4 sign flips) + ICP\nca = a5.mean(axis=0)\ncb = b5.mean(axis=0)\n_, va = np.linalg.eigh(np.cov((a5 - ca).T))\n_, vb = np.linalg.eigh(np.cov((b5 - cb).T))\n\nbest_rmse = 1e9\nbest_R = None\nbest_t = None\n\ntree_b5 = cKDTree(b5)\nsub_a = voxel_ds(a5, 0.015)\n\nfor sx in [-1, 1]:\n    for sy in [-1, 1]:\n        S = np.diag([sx, sy, 1.0])\n        R0 = vb @ S @ va.T\n        if np.linalg.det(R0) < 0:\n            S = np.diag([sx, sy, -1.0])\n            R0 = vb @ S @ va.T\n        R = R0.copy()\n        t = cb - R @ ca\n        # Run 40 iterations of trimmed ICP\n        for it in range(40):\n            trans = sub_a @ R.T + t\n            d, j = tree_b5.query(trans, k=1, workers=-1)\n            mask = d < np.quantile(d, 0.9)\n            src = sub_a[mask]\n            dst = b5[j[mask]]\n            ms = src.mean(axis=0)\n            md = dst.mean(axis=0)\n            H = (src - ms).T @ (dst - md)\n            U, _, Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)\n            R_new = Vt.T @ U.T\n            if np.linalg.det(R_new) < 0:\n                Vt[-1, :] *= -1\n                R_new = Vt.T @ U.T\n            R = R_new\n            t = md - R @ ms\n        trans = a5 @ R.T + t\n        d, _ = tree_b5.query(trans, k=1, workers=-1)\n        rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean(np.minimum(d, 0.05)**2))\n        print(f\"Sign ({sx},{sy}): median_err={np.median(d)*1000:.3f}mm, p99={np.quantile(d,0.99)*1000:.3f}mm, max={np.max(d)*1000:.3f}mm\")\n        if rmse < best_rmse:\n            best_rmse = rmse\n            best_R = R\n            best_t = t\n\n# Refine ICP on full 2mm clouds!\ntree_b2 = cKDTree(pts_b)\nR, t = best_R.copy(), best_t.copy()\nsub_a2 = voxel_ds(pts_a, 0.005)\nfor it in range(25):\n    trans = sub_a2 @ R.T + t\n    d, j = tree_b2.query(trans, k=1, workers=-1)\n    mask = d < 0.005\n    src = sub_a2[mask]\n    dst = pts_b[j[mask]]\n    ms = src.mean(axis=0)\n    md = dst.mean(axis=0)\n    H = (src - ms).T @ (dst - md)\n    U, _, Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)\n    R_new = Vt.T @ U.T\n    if np.linalg.det(R_new) < 0:\n        Vt[-1, :] *= -1\n        R_new = Vt.T @ U.T\n    R = R_new\n    t = md - R @ ms\n\nd_ab, _ = tree_b2.query(pts_a @ R.T + t, k=1, workers=-1)\nd_ba, _ = tree_a2.query((pts_b - t) @ R, k=1, workers=-1)\nprint(\"Refined ICP a->b quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(d_ab * 1000, [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 1.0]))\nprint(\"Refined ICP b->a quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(d_ba * 1000, [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 1.0]))\nprint(\"R_a_to_b:\\n\", R)\nprint(\"t_a_to_b:\", t)\nprint(\"Euler xyz (deg):\", Rotation.from_matrix(R).as_euler(\"xyz\", degrees=True))\nprint(\"Quat wxyz:\", np.roll(Rotation.from_matrix(R).as_quat(), 1))\n","filePath":"/app/analyze_tubes.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/analyze_tubes.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/analyze_tubes.py","time":{"start":1794648552240,"end":1794648552248}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d963b327001TYmsteakrOZq30","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d9633225001UF894lR6902Niy"}}

pts.min(axis=0)) / vs).astype(np.int64)\n    # 1D hash key (grid size < 10000 per axis)\n    keys = c[:, 0] * 100000000 + c[:, 1] * 10000 + c[:, 2]\n    _, idx = np.unique(keys, return_index=True)\n    return pts[idx]\n\na5 = voxel_ds(pts_a, 0.005)\nb5 = voxel_ds(pts_b, 0.005)\nprint(f\"5mm clouds: a={len(a5)}, b={len(b5)}\", flush=True)\n\ntree_a5 = cKDTree(a5)\ntree_b5 = cKDTree(b5)\ndists_ab, idx_a = tree_a5.query(b5, k=1, workers=-1)\nmin_idx = np.argmin(dists_ab)\nprint(f\"Initial min distance between tube_a and tube_b (5mm): {dists_ab[min_idx]*1000:.3f} mm\", flush=True)\nprint(f\"  closest point on a: {a5[idx_a[min_idx]]}, on b: {b5[min_idx]}\", flush=True)\n\n# Estimate surface normals on a5 and check tube radius\nrng = np.random.default_rng(42)\nsample_idx = rng.choice(len(a5), size=1000, replace=False)\n_, nn_idx = tree_a5.query(a5[sample_idx], k=35)\nneighbors = a5[nn_idx]\ncentered = neighbors - neighbors.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)\ncov = np.einsum(\"nki,nkj->nij\", centered, centered) / 35.0\neigvals, eigvecs = np.linalg.eigh(cov)\nnormals = eigvecs[:, :, 0]\n\nradii_est = []\nfor p, n in zip(a5[sample_idx[:400]], normals[:400]):\n    idxs = tree_a5.query_ball_point(p, 0.25)\n    diff = a5[idxs] - p\n    proj = diff @ n\n    perp = np.linalg.norm(diff - np.outer(proj, n), axis=1)\n    opp = np.abs(proj[(perp < 0.008) & (np.abs(proj) > 0.015)])\n    if len(opp) > 0:\n        radii_est.append(np.min(opp) / 2.0)\n\nradii_est = np.array(radii_est)\nprint(\"Estimated tube radius quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(radii_est * 1000, [0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95]), flush=True)\n\n# Find rigid transform from tube_a to tube_b using PCA initialization (4 sign flips) + ICP\nca = a5.mean(axis=0)\ncb = b5.mean(axis=0)\n_, va = np.linalg.eigh(np.cov((a5 - ca).T))\n_, vb = np.linalg.eigh(np.cov((b5 - cb).T))\n\nbest_rmse = 1e9\nbest_R = None\nbest_t = None\n\nsub_a = voxel_ds(a5, 0.015)\n\nfor sx in [-1, 1]:\n    for sy in [-1, 1]:\n        S = np.diag([sx, sy, 1.0])\n        R0 = vb @ S @ va.T\n        if np.linalg.det(R0) < 0:\n            S = np.diag([sx, sy, -1.0])\n            R0 = vb @ S @ va.T\n        R = R0.copy()\n        t = cb - R @ ca\n        for it in range(50):\n            trans = sub_a @ R.T + t\n            d, j = tree_b5.query(trans, k=1, workers=-1)\n            mask = d < np.quantile(d, 0.92)\n            src = sub_a[mask]\n            dst = b5[j[mask]]\n            ms = src.mean(axis=0)\n            md = dst.mean(axis=0)\n            H = (src - ms).T @ (dst - md)\n            U, _, Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)\n            R_new = Vt.T @ U.T\n            if np.linalg.det(R_new) < 0:\n                Vt[-1, :] *= -1\n                R_new = Vt.T @ U.T\n            R = R_new\n            t = md - R @ ms\n        trans = a5 @ R.T + t\n        d, _ = tree_b5.query(trans, k=1, workers=-1)\n        rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean(np.minimum(d, 0.05)**2))\n        print(f\"Sign ({sx},{sy}): median_err={np.median(d)*1000:.3f}mm, p99={np.quantile(d,0.99)*1000:.3f}mm, max={np.max(d)*1000:.3f}mm\", flush=True)\n        if rmse < best_rmse:\n            best_rmse = rmse\n            best_R = R\n            best_t = t\n\n# Refine on 5mm clouds\nR, t = best_R.copy(), best_t.copy()\nfor it in range(20):\n    trans = a5 @ R.T + t\n    d, j = tree_b5.query(trans, k=1, workers=-1)\n    mask = d < 0.008\n    src = a5[mask]\n    dst = b5[j[mask]]\n    ms = src.mean(axis=0)\n    md = dst.mean(axis=0)\n    H = (src - ms).T @ (dst - md)\n    U, _, Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)\n    R_new = Vt.T @ U.T\n    if np.linalg.det(R_new) < 0:\n        Vt[-1, :] *= -1\n        R_new = Vt.T @ U.T\n    R = R_new\n    t = md - R @ ms\n\nd_ab, _ = tree_b5.query(a5 @ R.T + t, k=1, workers=-1)\nd_ba, _ = tree_a5.query((b5 - t) @ R, k=1, workers=-1)\nprint(\"Refined ICP a->b quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(d_ab * 1000, [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 1.0]), flush=True)\nprint(\"Refined ICP b->a quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(d_ba * 1000, [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 1.0]), flush=True)\nprint(\"R_a_to_b:\\n\", R)\nprint(\"t_a_to_b:\", t)\nprint(\"Euler xyz (deg):\", Rotation.from_matrix(R).as_euler(\"xyz\", degrees=True))\nprint(\"Quat wxyz:\", np.roll(Rotation.from_matrix(R).as_quat(), 1))\n","filePath":"/app/analyze_tubes.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/analyze_tubes.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"app/analyze_tubes.py","time":{"start":1794648716576,"end":1794648716585}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d966351c0016ir6nx6XIHeBJq","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d965e023001mm970PQaHsKmT5"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794648841882,"sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"0lLLYm8FwYWcorGF","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation\n\ndata = np.load(\"/app/tubes_cloud.npz\")\npts_a = data[\"pts_a\"]\npts_b = data[\"pts_b\"]\n\ndef voxel_ds(pts, vs):\n    mn = pts.min(axis=0)\n    c = np.floor((pts - mn) / vs).astype(np.int64)\n    keys = c[:, 0] * 100000000 + c[:, 1] * 10000 + c[:, 2]\n    _, idx = np.unique(keys, return_index=True)\n    return pts[idx]\n\na3 = voxel_ds(pts_a, 0.003)\nb3 = voxel_ds(pts_b, 0.003)\nprint(f\"3mm clouds: a={len(a3)}, b={len(b3)}\", flush=True)\n\n# Check exact candidate rotation R = Rz(-20) @ Rx(-15) (intrinsic ZYX or extrinsic xyz [-15, 0, -20])\nR_exact = Rotation.from_euler(\"xyz\", [-15.0, 0.0, -20.0], degrees=True).as_matrix()\n\n# Estimate normals on b3 for point-to-plane ICP\ntree_b3 = cKDTree(b3)\n_, nn_b = tree_b3.query(b3, k=20, workers=-1)\nnb = b3[nn_b]\nnb_c = nb - nb.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)\ncov_b = np.einsum(\"nki,nkj->nij\", nb_c, nb_c)\n_, vecs_b = np.linalg.eigh(cov_b)\nnormals_b = vecs_b[:, :, 0]\n\n# Point-to-plane ICP starting from R_exact and t0 = [0.15655, 0.01734, 0.34747]\nR = R_exact.copy()\nt = np.array([0.156548, 0.017338, 0.347465], dtype=np.float64)\n\nsub_a = voxel_ds(pts_a, 0.006)\nfor it in range(20):\n    p = sub_a @ R.T + t\n    d, j = tree_b3.query(p, k=1, workers=-1)\n    mask = d < 0.005\n    p_m = p[mask]\n    q_m = b3[j[mask]]\n    n_m = normals_b[j[mask]]\n    # Linearize: (p_m + omega x p_m + dt - q_m) . n_m = 0\n    # omega . (p_m x n_m) + dt . n_m = (q_m - p_m) . n_m\n    A = np.hstack([np.cross(p_m, n_m), n_m])\n    rhs = np.sum((q_m - p_m) * n_m, axis=1)\n    sol, _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, rhs, rcond=None)\n    dR = Rotation.from_rotvec(sol[:3]).as_matrix()\n    dt = sol[3:]\n    R = dR @ R\n    t = dR @ t + dt\n\n# Check point-to-plane residual with refined R, t AND with exact [-15, 0, -20]\np_ref = a3 @ R.T + t\nd_ref, j_ref = tree_b3.query(p_ref, k=1, workers=-1)\np2plane = np.abs(np.sum((p_ref - b3[j_ref]) * normals_b[j_ref], axis=1))\nprint(\"Point-to-plane error quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(p2plane * 1000, [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999]), flush=True)\nprint(\"Point-to-point error quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(d_ref * 1000, [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 1.0]), flush=True)\nprint(\"Refined Euler xyz (deg):\", Rotation.from_matrix(R).as_euler(\"xyz\", degrees=True))\nprint(\"Refined t:\", repr(t))\n\n# Wait: check where t comes from! What is R @ [1.2, 0.36, 0.28]? Or [1.2, 0.36, 0.28] - R @ something?\npos_b0 = np.array([1.2, 0.36, 0.28])\nprint(\"pos_b0 - t =\", pos_b0 - t)\nprint(\"R.T @ (pos_b0 - t) =\", R.T @ (pos_b0 - t))\n\n# Merge a and b->a to get complete cloud of tube_a!\npts_b_in_a = (pts_b - t) @ R\nmerged_a = voxel_ds(np.vstack([pts_a, pts_b_in_a]), 0.002)\nprint(f\"Merged 2mm cloud of tube_a: {len(merged_a)} points (was {len(pts_a)})\", flush=True)\n\n# Check if any region had points only from b (i.e. occluded on a!)\ntree_orig_a = cKDTree(a3)\nd_new, _ = tree_orig_a.query(merged_a, k=1, workers=-1)\nprint(f\"Max distance from merged_a to orig_a: {d_new.max()*1000:.2f} mm; points > 4mm: {np.sum(d_new > 0.004)}\", flush=True)\n\n# Save exact transform and merged cloud\nnp.savez_compressed(\"/app/tube_model.npz\", merged_a=merged_a, R_a_to_b=R, t_a_to_b=t, pos_b0=pos_b0)\n","filePath":"/app/inspect_exact_mesh.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/inspect_exact_mesh.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/inspect_exact_mesh.py","time":{"start":1794648841863,"end":1794648841877}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d9681e7c001daXS4p5s9OTfgm","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d966f754001geMA0GTL0g8yP3"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794648943024,"sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"9wVerxVcHexDkuBd","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/app/build_sdf.py","content":"import time\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.ndimage import binary_dilation, binary_fill_holes, distance_transform_edt\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\n\nt0 = time.time()\ndata = np.load(\"/app/tube_model.npz\")\nmerged_a = data[\"merged_a\"]\nR_a_to_b = data[\"R_a_to_b\"]\nt_a_to_b = data[\"t_a_to_b\"]\npos_b0 = data[\"pos_b0\"]\n\nprint(f\"Loaded merged_a: {len(merged_a)} pts\", flush=True)\nbbox_min = merged_a.min(axis=0)\nbbox_max = merged_a.max(axis=0)\nprint(\"merged_a bbox:\", bbox_min, \"to\", bbox_max, flush=True)\n\n# Grid with 4.0 mm spacing and 0.25 m margin\ndx = 0.004\nmargin = 0.25\ngrid_min = np.floor((bbox_min - margin) / dx) * dx\ngrid_max = np.ceil((bbox_max + margin) / dx) * dx\nshape = np.round((grid_max - grid_min) / dx).astype(int) + 1\nprint(f\"Grid dx={dx*1000:.1f}mm, shape={tuple(shape)}, total={np.prod(shape)/1e6:.1f}M voxels\", flush=True)\n\n# Rasterize merged_a onto a 2.0mm subgrid FIRST for ultra-clean hole-filling, or directly on 4.0mm!\n# Let's check on 4.0mm: since merged_a has 2mm spacing, every surface cell is hit!\nijk = np.round((merged_a - grid_min) / dx).astype(int)\nsurface_mask = np.zeros(shape, dtype=bool)\nsurface_mask[ijk[:, 0], ijk[:, 1], ijk[:, 2]] = True\n\n# Dilate by 1 voxel (3x3x3 connectivity) just in case a diagonal voxel was grazed, fill holes, erode back?\n# Wait: binary_fill_holes on surface_mask directly vs 1-voxel closing! Let's compare both!\nfilled_direct = binary_fill_holes(surface_mask)\ndilated = binary_dilation(surface_mask, iterations=1)\nfilled_dilated = binary_fill_holes(dilated)\n\nprint(f\"Surface voxels: {surface_mask.sum()}\", flush=True)\nprint(f\"Filled direct voxels: {filled_direct.sum()} (vol = {filled_direct.sum() * dx**3:.5f} m^3)\", flush=True)\nprint(f\"Filled dilated voxels: {filled_dilated.sum()} (vol = {filled_dilated.sum() * dx**3:.5f} m^3)\", flush=True)\n\n# Notice: if filled_direct leaked, its volume would equal surface_mask (~0.005 m^3). If watertight, vol ~ 0.15 m^3!\n# Let's refine sign near boundary using outward surface normals of merged_a!\n# Compute unsigned EDT from ~surface_mask (or exact cKDTree near boundary? Wait: EDT on 4mm grid!)\n# Wait: let's check accuracy of EDT vs exact cKDTree on random test points!\ninside_rough = filled_dilated & (~dilated)\n# Wait: inside_rough is guaranteed strictly inside tube_a! What about the 1-voxel band `dilated`?\n# There are only ~2M voxels in `dilated`! We can compute EXACT signed distance on `dilated` (and within 3 voxels) using cKDTree + outward normals!\nprint(f\"Voxels in dilated shell: {dilated.sum()}\", flush=True)\n\n# Let's compute outward normals on a 3mm downsampled cloud of merged_a!\ndef voxel_ds(pts, vs):\n    mn = pts.min(axis=0)\n    c = np.floor((pts - mn) / vs).astype(np.int64)\n    keys = c[:, 0] * 100000000 + c[:, 1] * 10000 + c[:, 2]\n    _, idx = np.unique(keys, return_index=True)\n    return pts[idx]\n\na3 = voxel_ds(merged_a, 0.003)\ntree_a3 = cKDTree(a3)\n_, nn_idx = tree_a3.query(a3, k=25, workers=-1)\nnb = a3[nn_idx]\nnb_c = nb - nb.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n_, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(np.einsum(\"nki,nkj->nij\", nb_c, nb_c))\nnormals = vecs[:, :, 0]\n\n# Orient normals OUTWARD using `inside_rough`!\n# Specifically, for each point p in a3, check p - 0.02 * n vs p + 0.02 * n in `inside_rough`!\np_minus = np.clip(np.round((a3 - 0.02 * normals - grid_min) / dx).astype(int), 0, shape - 1)\np_plus = np.clip(np.round((a3 + 0.02 * normals - grid_min) / dx).astype(int), 0, shape - 1)\nin_minus = inside_rough[p_minus[:, 0], p_minus[:, 1], p_minus[:, 2]]\nin_plus = inside_rough[p_plus[:, 0], p_plus[:, 1], p_plus[:, 2]]\nflip = in_plus & (~in_minus)\nnormals[flip] *= -1.0\nambig = (in_plus == in_minus)\nprint(f\"Normal orientation: {len(a3)} pts, flipped={flip.sum()}, ambiguous={ambig.sum()}\", flush=True)\nif ambig.sum() > 0:\n    # try 0.04m step for any ambiguous\n    pm2 = np.clip(np.round((a3[ambig] - 0.04 * normals[ambig] - grid_min) / dx).astype(int), 0, shape - 1)\n    pp2 = np.clip(np.round((a3[ambig] + 0.04 * normals[ambig] - grid_min) / dx).astype(int), 0, shape - 1)\n    im2 = inside_rough[pm2[:, 0], pm2[:, 1], pm2[:, 2]]\n    ip2 = inside_rough[pp2[:, 0], pp2[:, 1], pp2[:, 2]]\n    normals_amb = normals[ambig]\n    normals_amb[ip2 & (~im2)] *= -1.0\n    normals[ambig] = normals_amb\n    print(f\"Remaining ambiguous after 0.04m test: {(ip2 == im2).sum()}\", flush=True)\n\n# Now determine exact inside/outside for ALL voxels in `dilated` using dot(voxel_center - nearest_a3, normal) < 0!\nshell_ijk = np.argwhere(dilated)\nshell_xyz = grid_min + shell_ijk * dx\nd_shell, j_shell = tree_a3.query(shell_xyz, k=1, workers=-1)\ndot_shell = np.sum((shell_xyz - a3[j_shell]) * normals[j_shell], axis=1)\ninside_exact = inside_rough.copy()\ninside_exact[shell_ijk[:, 0], shell_ijk[:, 1], shell_ijk[:, 2]] = (dot_shell < 0.0)\nprint(f\"Exact inside volume: {inside_exact.sum() * dx**3:.5f} m^3\", flush=True)\n\n# Compute EDT outside and inside, then overwrite narrow band with exact cKDTree signed distance!\nprint(\"Computing EDT...\", flush=True)\nedt_out = distance_transform_edt(~inside_exact) * dx\nedt_in = distance_transform_edt(inside_exact) * dx\nsdf = edt_out - edt_in  # note: off by ~dx/2 at voxel boundary, so overwrite narrow band!\n\nband = (np.abs(sdf) <= 0.030)\nband_ijk = np.argwhere(band)\nprint(f\"Refining narrow band ({len(band_ijk)} voxels) with exact cKDTree...\", flush=True)\n# Process in chunks of 1M to save RAM\ntree_full = cKDTree(merged_a)\nchunk = 1000000\nfor s in range(0, len(band_ijk), chunk):\n    e = min(s + chunk, len(band_ijk))\n    b_ijk = band_ijk[s:e]\n    b_xyz = grid_min + b_ijk * dx\n    d_exact, _ = tree_full.query(b_xyz, k=1, workers=-1)\n    sign = np.where(inside_exact[b_ijk[:, 0], b_ijk[:, 1], b_ijk[:, 2]], -1.0, 1.0)\n    sdf[b_ijk[:, 0], b_ijk[:, 1], b_ijk[:, 2]] = sign * d_exact\n\nprint(f\"SDF min={sdf.min()*1000:.2f} mm, max={sdf.max()*1000:.2f} mm, elapsed={time.time()-t0:.1f}s\", flush=True)\n\n# Verify trilinear SDF accuracy on random points near surface!\nrng = np.random.default_rng(0)\ntest_pts = a3[rng.choice(len(a3), 5000)] + rng.normal(0, 0.012, size=(5000, 3))\nd_true, j_true = tree_full.query(test_pts, k=1, workers=-1)\n_, j_n = tree_a3.query(test_pts, k=1, workers=-1)\ns_true = np.where(np.sum((test_pts - a3[j_n]) * normals[j_n], axis=1) < 0, -1.0, 1.0)\nsd_true = s_true * d_true\n\n# Trilinear interpolation\ncoords = (test_pts - grid_min) / dx\ni0 = np.floor(coords).astype(int)\nf = coords - i0\nc000 = sdf[i0[:,0], i0[:,1], i0[:,2]]\nc100 = sdf[i0[:,0]+1, i0[:,1], i0[:,2]]\nc010 = sdf[i0[:,0], i0[:,1]+1, i0[:,2]]\nc110 = sdf[i0[:,0]+1, i0[:,1]+1, i0[:,2]]\nc001 = sdf[i0[:,0], i0[:,1], i0[:,2]+1]\nc101 = sdf[i0[:,0]+1, i0[:,1], i0[:,2]+1]\nc011 = sdf[i0[:,0], i0[:,1]+1, i0[:,2]+1]\nc111 = sdf[i0[:,0]+1, i0[:,1]+1, i0[:,2]+1]\nc00 = c000*(1-f[:,0]) + c100*f[:,0]\nc01 = c001*(1-f[:,0]) + c101*f[:,0]\nc10 = c010*(1-f[:,0]) + c110*f[:,0]\nc11 = c011*(1-f[:,0]) + c111*f[:,0]\nc0 = c00*(1-f[:,1]) + c10*f[:,1]\nc1 = c01*(1-f[:,1]) + c11*f[:,1]\nsd_interp = c0*(1-f[:,2]) + c1*f[:,2]\n\nerr = np.abs(sd_interp - sd_true)\nprint(\"Trilinear SDF error quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(err * 1000, [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 1.0]), flush=True)\n\n# Save SDF as int16 in 0.1 mm units (exact to 0.05 mm, range +-3.27m, only 223 MB!) and surface cloud of tube_b in local frame!\nsdf_i16 = np.clip(np.round(sdf * 10000.0), -32767, 32767).astype(np.int16)\n# Also create multi-resolution surface clouds of tube_b in tube_b's body frame (centered at pos_b0 = [1.2, 0.36, 0.28], quat=[1,0,0,0]):\n# Since merged_a is complete, tube_b at initial pose is merged_a @ R_a_to_b.T + t_a_to_b, and in body frame subtract pos_b0!\nb_full_local = (merged_a @ R_a_to_b.T + t_a_to_b) - pos_b0\nb_coarse = voxel_ds(b_full_local, 0.025) # ~25mm spacing (~2500 pts)\nb_med = voxel_ds(b_full_local, 0.010)    # ~10mm spacing (~15000 pts)\nb_fine = voxel_ds(b_full_local, 0.005)   # ~5mm spacing (~60000 pts)\n\n# Also extract medial axis spheres of tube_a -> transform to tube_b local frame!\n# Voxels with sdf < -0.085 m!\nmed_ijk = np.argwhere(sdf < -0.085)\nmed_xyz_a = grid_min + med_ijk * dx\nmed_r_a = -sdf[med_ijk[:, 0], med_ijk[:, 1], med_ijk[:, 2]]\n# Greedy covering along medial axis (every 25mm)\norder = np.argsort(-med_r_a)\nkept_c = []\nkept_r = []\nfor idx in order:\n    c = med_xyz_a[idx]\n    if len(kept_c) == 0 or np.min(np.linalg.norm(np.array(kept_c) - c, axis=1)) > 0.025:\n        kept_c.append(c)\n        kept_r.append(med_r_a[idx])\nkept_c = np.array(kept_c)\nkept_r = np.array(kept_r)\nkept_c_b_local = (kept_c @ R_a_to_b.T + t_a_to_b) - pos_b0\nprint(f\"Medial spheres: {len(kept_c)}, radii min={kept_r.min()*1000:.1f}mm max={kept_r.max()*1000:.1f}mm\", flush=True)\nprint(f\"Surface clouds b_local: coarse={len(b_coarse)}, med={len(b_med)}, fine={len(b_fine)}\", flush=True)\n\nnp.savez(\n    \"/app/planner_data.npz\",\n    sdf_i16=sdf_i16,\n    grid_min=grid_min.astype(np.float64),\n    grid_max=grid_max.astype(np.float64),\n    dx=np.float64(dx),\n    shape=shape.astype(np.int32),\n    bbox_a_min=bbox_min.astype(np.float64),\n    bbox_a_max=bbox_max.astype(np.float64),\n    pos_b0=pos_b0.astype(np.float64),\n    b_coarse=b_coarse.astype(np.float32),\n    b_med=b_med.astype(np.float32),\n    b_fine=b_fine.astype(np.float32),\n    med_c_b=kept_c_b_local.astype(np.float32),\n    med_r_b=kept_r.astype(np.float32),\n)\nprint(\"Saved /app/planner_data.npz!\", flush=True)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/build_sdf.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/build_sdf.py","time":{"start":1794648943005,"end":1794648943020}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d969a994001jk6Adg5KSDlJeu","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d9685a73001gfwkdTWm2vM0z9"}}

np.load(\"/app/tube_model.npz\")\nmerged_a = data[\"merged_a\"].astype(np.float32)\nR_a_to_b = data[\"R_a_to_b\"]\nt_a_to_b = data[\"t_a_to_b\"]\npos_b0 = data[\"pos_b0\"]\ndel data\ngc.collect()\n\nprint(f\"Loaded merged_a: {len(merged_a)} pts\", flush=True)\nbbox_min = merged_a.min(axis=0).astype(np.float64)\nbbox_max = merged_a.max(axis=0).astype(np.float64)\n\ndx = dx={dx*1000:.1f}mm, shape={tuple(shape)}, total={np.prod(shape)/1e6:.2f}M voxels\", flush=True)\n\nijk = np.round((merged_a - grid_min) / dx).astype(int)\nsurface_mask = np.zeros(shape, binary_fill_holes(dilated)\ninside_rough = filled_dilated & (~dilated)\ndel filled_dilated\ngc.collect()\nprint(f\"Rough inside volume: {inside_rough.sum() * dx**3:.5f} m^3, dilated shell: {dilated.sum()}\", flush=True)\n\ndef voxel_ds(pts, vs):\n    mn = pts.min(axis=0)\n    c = np.floor((pts - mn) / vs).astype(np.int64)\n    keys = c[:, 0] * 100000000 + c[:, 1] * 10000 + c[:, 2]\n    _, idx = np.unique(keys, return_index=True)\n    return pts[idx]\n\na3 = voxel_ds(merged_a, 0.0035)\ntree_a3 = cKDTree(a3)\n_, nn_idx = tree_a3.query(a3, k=25, workers=-1)\nnb = a3[nn_idx].astype(np.float64)\nnb_c = nb - nb.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n_, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(np.einsum(\"nki,nkj->nij\", nb_c, nb_c))\nnormals = vecs[:, :, 0].astype(np.float32)\ndel nb, nb_c, vecs, nn_idx\ngc.collect()\n\n# Orient normals outward using inside_rough\nfor step in [0.025, 0.045]:\n    p_minus = np.clip(np.round((a3 - step * normals - grid_min) / dx).astype(int), 0, shape - 1)\n    p_plus = np.clip(np.round((a3 + step * normals - grid_min) / dx).astype(int), 0, shape - 1)\n    in_minus = inside_rough[p_minus[:, 0], p_minus[:, 1], p_minus[:, 2]]\n    in_plus = inside_rough[p_plus[:, 0], p_plus[:, 1], p_plus[:, 2]]\n    flip = in_plus & (~in_minus)\n    normals[flip] *= -1.0\n    ambig = (in_plus == in_minus)\n    print(f\"Step {step}m: flipped={flip.sum()}, ambig={ambig.sum()}\", flush=True)\n\n# Exact sign on dilated shell\nshell_ijk = np.argwhere(dilated)\ndel dilated\ninside_exact = inside_rough\nchunk = 500000\nfor s in range(0, len(shell_ijk), chunk):\n    e = min(s + chunk, len(shell_ijk))\n    b_ijk = shell_ijk[s:e]\n    b_xyz = (grid_min + b_ijk * dx).astype(np.float32)\n    _, j_s = tree_a3.query(b_xyz, k=1, workers=-1)\n    dot_s = np.sum((b_xyz - a3[j_s]) * normals[j_s], axis=1)\n    inside_exact[b_ijk[:, 0], b_ijk[:, 1], b_ijk[:, 2]] = (dot_s < 0.0)\ndel shell_ijk\ngc.collect()\nprint(f\"Exact inside volume: {inside_exact.sum() * dx**3:.5f} m^3\", flush=True)\n\nprint(\"Computing outside EDT...\", flush=True)\nsdf = (distance_transform_edt(~inside_exact) * c01*(1-f[:,1]) + c11*f[:,1]\nsd_interp = c0*(1-f[:,2]) + c1*f[:,2]\n\nerr = np.abs(sd_interp - sd_true)\nprint(\"Trilinear SDF error quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(err * 1000, [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 1.0]), flush=True)\n\nsdf_i16 = np.clip(np.round(sdf * 10000.0), -32767, 32767).astype(np.int16)\n\n# Extract medial spheres before deleting sdf\nmed_ijk = np.argwhere(sdf < -0.080)\nmed_xyz_a = grid_min + med_ijk * dx\nmed_r_a = -sdf[med_ijk[:, 0], med_ijk[:, 1], med_ijk[:, 2]]\norder = np.argsort(-med_r_a)\nkept_c = []\nkept_r = []\nfor idx in order:\n    c = med_xyz_a[idx]\n    if {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794649203014,"sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"jM2ZXVWzqiyB67Wb","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/app/check_slice.py","content":"import numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\n\ndata = np.load(\"/app/tube_model.npz\")\na = data[\"merged_a\"]\nprint(\"Total points:\", len(a))\n\n# Slice near x = 1.0 (|x - 1.0| < 0.005)\nfor x0 in [0.2, 0.6, 1.0, 1.4, 1.8, 2.2]:\n    sl = a[np.abs(a[:, 0] - x0) < 0.005]\n    print(f\"\\nSlice x={x0}: {len(sl)} pts\")\n    if len(sl) > 0:\n        # Cluster in yz plane!\n        tree = cKDTree(sl[:, 1:])\n        # Connected components at r=0.03m\n        visited = np.zeros(len(sl), dtype=bool)\n        clusters = []\n        for i in range(len(sl)):\n            if not visited[i]:\n                q = [i]\n                visited[i] = True\n                comp = []\n                while q:\n                    u = q.pop()\n                    comp.append(u)\n                    for v in tree.query_ball_point(sl[u, 1:], 0.03):\n                        if not visited[v]:\n                            visited[v] = True\n                            q.append(v)\n                pts_c = sl[comp, 1:]\n                center = pts_c.mean(axis=0)\n                r_dists = np.linalg.norm(pts_c - center, axis=1)\n                print(f\"  cluster n={len(comp)}, center_yz={center.round(4)}, span_yz={(pts_c.max(0)-pts_c.min(0)).round(4)}, r_min={r_dists.min()*1000:.1f}mm, r_max={r_dists.max()*1000:.1f}mm\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/check_slice.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/check_slice.py","time":{"start":1794649203002,"end":1794649203011}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d96da133001iXb5UyUL09klxs","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d96d1559001eViKDMRv4jNv2X"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794649270817,"sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"EP8mO7fazT9FAbnf","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import gc\nimport time\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.ndimage import binary_dilation, binary_fill_holes, distance_transform_edt\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\n\nt0 = time.time()\ndata = np.load(\"/app/tube_model.npz\")\nmerged_a = data[\"merged_a\"].astype(np.float32)\nR_a_to_b = data[\"R_a_to_b\"]\nt_a_to_b = data[\"t_a_to_b\"]\npos_b0 = data[\"pos_b0\"]\ndel data\n\ndef voxel_ds(pts, vs):\n    mn = pts.min(axis=0)\n    c = np.floor((pts - mn) / vs).astype(np.int64)\n    keys = c[:, 0] * 100000000 + c[:, 1] * 10000 + c[:, 2]\n    _, idx = np.unique(keys, return_index=True)\n    return pts[idx]\n\na5 = voxel_ds(merged_a, 0.005)\ntree5 = cKDTree(a5)\n\n# Trace centerline starting from the known end at x=2.34, y=0.914, z=-0.069 going in -x direction!\nc_cur = np.array([2.33, 0.914, -0.069], dtype=np.float64)\ndir_cur = np.array([-1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=np.float64)\nstep_len = 0.025  # 25 mm steps along spine\n\nspine = []\n# First refine exact tip at start end (+dir = +x)\nidxs_tip0 = tree5.query_ball_point(c_cur, 0.14)\npts_tip0 = a5[idxs_tip0]\n# Project onto +x\ns_max0 = np.max((pts_tip0 - c_cur) @ (-dir_cur))\ntip0_center = c_cur - dir_cur * s_max0\n# Refine cross-section center perpendicular to dir_cur\nsl0 = pts_tip0[np.abs((pts_tip0 - tip0_center) @ dir_cur) < 0.015]\ntip0_center = sl0.mean(axis=0)\nprint(f\"Start tip0_center: {tip0_center}, n_ring={len(sl0)}\", flush=True)\n\nspine.append(tip0_center.copy())\nc_cur = tip0_center.copy()\n\nfor step_i in range(300):\n    c_pred = c_cur + dir_cur * step_len\n    # Find ring of surface points near plane (p - c_pred) . dir_cur = 0 within radius 0.16m\n    idxs = tree5.query_ball_point(c_pred, 0.16)\n    if len(idxs) < 20:\n        print(f\"Reached other end at step {step_i}, c_cur={c_cur}\", flush=True)\n        break\n    pts_loc = a5[idxs].astype(np.float64)\n    along = (pts_loc - c_pred) @ dir_cur\n    perp_vec = (pts_loc - c_pred) - np.outer(along, dir_cur)\n    perp_r = np.linalg.norm(perp_vec, axis=1)\n    # Keep points on THIS branch of the tube (perp_r < 0.135m and |along| < 0.020m)\n    ring = pts_loc[(perp_r < 0.135) & (np.abs(along) < 0.020)]\n    if len(ring) < 15:\n        print(f\"Ring ended at step {step_i}, n={len(ring)}, c_cur={c_cur}\", flush=True)\n        break\n    # Fit circle/ring center in the plane perpendicular to dir_cur!\n    # Notice: mean of a uniform ring is the exact center, EXCEPT right at the tip if truncated!\n    # Check max projection forward along dir_cur to see if we hit the end of the tube\n    ahead = pts_loc[perp_r < 0.135]\n    max_ahead = np.max((ahead - c_cur) @ dir_cur)\n    if max_ahead < step_len * 0.7:\n        # Refine exact tip!\n        tip1_center = c_cur + dir_cur * max_ahead\n        sl1 = ahead[np.abs((ahead - tip1_center) @ dir_cur) < 0.015]\n        if len(sl1) >= 10:\n            # Project onto plane at max_ahead\n            tip1_center = sl1.mean(axis=0)\n        spine.append(tip1_center)\n        print(f\"Exact end tip1_center at step {step_i}: {tip1_center}, max_ahead={max_ahead*1000:.1f}mm\", flush=True)\n        break\n    c_new = ring.mean(axis=0)\n    # Re-project c_new to stay ~step_len ahead along dir_cur so it doesn't drift backward\n    c_new = c_pred + (c_new - c_pred) - ((c_new - c_pred) @ dir_cur) * dir_cur\n    d_new = c_new - c_cur\n    d_new /= np.linalg.norm(d_new)\n    c_cur = c_new\n    dir_cur = d_new\n    spine.append(c_cur.copy())\n\nspine = np.array(spine)\nprint(f\"Traced spine: {len(spine)} points, total arc length = {np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(spine, axis=0), axis=1)):.3f} m\", flush=True)\nprint(\"Spine start:\", spine[0], \"end:\", spine[-1], flush=True)\n\n# Verify that EVERY point of a5 is within ~0.115 m of `spine`!\ntree_spine = cKDTree(spine)\nd_to_spine, seg_idx = tree_spine.query(a5, k=1, workers=-1)\nprint(\"Distance of ALL surface points to traced spine quantiles (mm):\",\n      np.quantile(d_to_spine * 1000, [0.0, 0.05, 0.5, 0.95, 0.99, 1.0]), flush=True)\n","filePath":"/app/trace_and_seal.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/trace_and_seal.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/trace_and_seal.py","time":{"start":1794649270811,"end":1794649270816}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d96eaa18001pWVD95jzKfGIw9","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d96e089c001llBIChDR0h9RrN"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794649321560,"sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"COobU0D2U2tZMtMR","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/app/ascii_view.py","content":"import numpy as np\n\ndata = np.load(\"/app/tubes_cloud.npz\")\na = data[\"pts_a\"][::50]\nb = data[\"pts_b\"][::50]\n\ndef ascii_plot(pts1, pts2, ax0, ax1, title, width=80, height=32):\n    all_p = np.vstack([pts1, pts2])\n    mn0, mx0 = all_p[:, ax0].min() - 0.05, all_p[:, ax0].max() + 0.05\n    mn1, mx1 = all_p[:, ax1].min() - 0.05, all_p[:, ax1].max() + 0.05\n    grid = [[\" \" for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]\n    for p, ch in [(pts1, \"A\"), (pts2, \"b\")]:\n        u = np.clip(((p[:, ax0] - mn0) / (mx0 - mn0) * (width - 1)).astype(int), 0, width - 1)\n        v = np.clip(((mx1 - p[:, ax1]) / (mx1 - mn1) * (height - 1)).astype(int), 0, height - 1)\n        for ui, vi in zip(u, v):\n            if grid[vi][ui] == \" \":\n                grid[vi][ui] = ch\n            elif grid[vi][ui] != ch:\n                grid[vi][ui] = \"#\"\n    print(f\"=== {title} (horiz=[{mn0:.2f}..{mx0:.2f}], vert=[{mn1:.2f}..{mx1:.2f}]) ===\")\n    for row in grid:\n        print(\"\".join(row))\n\nascii_plot(a, b, 0, 1, \"TOP VIEW (X horiz, Y vert)\")\nascii_plot(a, b, 0, 2, \"FRONT VIEW (X horiz, Z vert)\", height=20)\nascii_plot(a, b, 1, 2, \"SIDE VIEW (Y horiz, Z vert)\", height=20)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/ascii_view.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/ascii_view.py","time":{"start":1794649321555,"end":1794649321559}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d96f7050001gHyN0ZbuqGDRoM","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d96f3b270014u4hyYurVPUt3d"}}

0.002, 0.5 * (end2_ring[:, 2].min() + end2_ring[:, 2].max())])\nr2 = np.linalg.norm(end2_ring[:, [0, 2]] - c2[[0, 2]], axis=1)\nprint(f\"End 2 (+y): center={c2}, n={len(end2_ring)}, r_min={r2.min()*1000:.1f}mm, r_max={r2.max()*1000:.1f}mm\", flush=True)\n\n# Generate dense 2mm cap points for End 1 and End 2 (inside the 12-gon / circle up to r_max)!\n# Better yet: clip cap points to convex hull of end1_ring[:, 1:] and end2_ring[:, [0, 2]]!\nfrom scipy.spatial import Delaunay\nhull1 = Delaunay(end1_ring[:, 1:])\ngy1, gz1 = np.meshgrid(\n    np.arange(end1_ring[:, 1].min(), end1_ring[:, 1].max(), 0.002),\n    np.arange(end1_ring[:, 2].min(), end1_ring[:, 2].max(), 0.002),\n)\ncand1 = np.column_stack([gy1.ravel(), gz1.ravel()])\nin1 = hull1.find_simplex(cand1) >= 0\ncap1 = np.column_stack([np.full(in1.sum(), end1_ring[:, 0].mean()), cand1[in1]]).astype(np.float32)\n\nhull2 = Delaunay(end2_ring[:, [0, 2]])\ngx2, gz2 = np.meshgrid(\n    np.arange(end2_ring[:, 0].min(), end2_ring[:, 0].max(), 0.002),\n    np.arange(end2_ring[:, 2].min(), end2_ring[:, 2].max(), 0.002),\n)\ncand2 = np.column_stack([gx2.ravel(), gz2.ravel()])\nin2 = hull2.find_simplex(cand2) >= 0\ncap2 = np.column_stack([cand2[in2, 0], np.full(in2.sum(), end2_ring[:, 1].mean()), cand2[in2, 1]]).astype(np.float32)\n\nprint(f\"Generated cap points: cap1={len(cap1)}, cap2={len(cap2)}\", flush=True)\nsealed_a = np.vstack([merged_a, cap1, cap2])\ndel merged_a\n\nbbox_min = sealed_a.min(axis=0).astype(np.float64)\nbbox_max = sealed_a.max(axis=0).astype(np.float64)\n\ndx = 0.005\nmargin = 0.20\ngrid_min = np.floor((bbox_min - margin) / dx) * dx\ngrid_max = np.ceil((bbox_max + margin) / dx) * dx\nshape = np.round((grid_max - grid_min) / dx).astype(int) + 1\nprint(f\"Grid dx={dx*1000:.1f}mm, shape={tuple(shape)}, total={np.prod(shape)/1e6:.2f}M voxels\", flush=True)\n\nijk = np.round((sealed_a - nb.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n_, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(np.einsum(\"nki,nkj->nij\", nb_c, nb_c))\nnormals = vecs[:, :, 0].astype(np.float32)\ndel nb, nb_c, vecs, nn_idx\ngc.collect()\n\n# Orient normals outward using inside_rough\nfor step in [0.025, 0.050]:\n    p_minus = np.clip(np.round((a3 - a3[j_s]) * normals[j_s], axis=1)\n    inside_exact[b_ijk[:, 0], b_ijk[:, 1], b_ijk[:, 2]] = (dot_s < 0.0)\ndel shell_ijk\ngc.collect()\nprint(f\"Exact inside volume: {inside_exact.sum() * dx**3:.5f} m^3\", flush=True)\n\nprint(\"Computing outside EDT...\", flush=True)\nsdf = (distance_transform_edt(~inside_exact) * dx).astype(np.float32)\ngc.collect()\nprint(\"Computing inside EDT...\", flush=True)\nsdf -= (distance_transform_edt(inside_exact) * dx).astype(np.float32)\ngc.collect()\n\nband_ijk = np.argwhere(np.abs(sdf) <= 0.030)\nprint(f\"Refining narrow band ({len(band_ijk)} voxels) with exact cKDTree...\", flush=True)\ntree_full = cKDTree(sealed_a)\nfor s in range(0, len(band_ijk), chunk):\n    e = min(s + chunk, len(band_ijk))\n    b_ijk = band_ijk[s:e]\n    b_xyz = (grid_min + b_ijk * dx).astype(np.float32)\n    d_exact, _ = tree_full.query(b_xyz, k=1, workers=-1)\n    sign = np.where(inside_exact[b_ijk[:, 0], b_ijk[:, 1], b_ijk[:, 2]], -1.0, 1.0).astype(np.float32)\n    sdf[b_ijk[:, 0], b_ijk[:, 1], b_ijk[:, 2]] = sign * d_exact.astype(np.float32)\ndel band_ijk, inside_exact\ngc.collect()\n\nprint(f\"SDF min={sdf.min()*1000:.2f} mm, max={sdf.max()*1000:.2f} mm, elapsed={time.time()-t0:.1f}s\", flush=True)\n\n# Verify trilinear SDF accuracy on random points near surface!\nrng = np.random.default_rng(0)\ntest_pts = a3[rng.choice(len(a3), 5000)] + rng.normal(0, 0.012, size=(5000, 3)).astype(np.float32)\nd_true, _ = tree_full.query(test_pts, k=1, workers=-1)\n_, j_n = tree_a3.query(test_pts, k=1, workers=-1)\ns_true = np.where(np.sum((test_pts - a3[j_n]) * normals[j_n], axis=1) < 0, -1.0, 1.0)\nsd_true = s_true * d_true\n\ncoords = (test_pts - grid_min) / dx\ni0 = np.floor(coords).astype(int)\nf = coords - i0\nc000 = sdf[i0[:,0], i0[:,1], i0[:,2]]\nc100 = sdf[i0[:,0]+1, i0[:,1], i0[:,2]]\nc010 = sdf[i0[:,0], i0[:,1]+1, i0[:,2]]\nc110 = sdf[i0[:,0]+1, i0[:,1]+1, i0[:,2]]\nc001 = sdf[i0[:,0], i0[:,1], i0[:,2]+1]\nc101 = sdf[i0[:,0]+1, i0[:,1], i0[:,2]+1]\nc011 = sdf[i0[:,0], i0[:,1]+1, i0[:,2]+1]\nc111 = sdf[i0[:,0]+1, i0[:,1]+1, i0[:,2]+1]\nc00 = c000*(1-f[:,0]) + c100*f[:,0]\nc01 = c001*(1-f[:,0]) + c101*f[:,0]\nc10 = c010*(1-f[:,0]) + c110*f[:,0]\nc11 = c011*(1-f[:,0]) + c111*f[:,0]\nc0 = c00*(1-f[:,1]) + c10*f[:,1]\nc1 = c01*(1-f[:,1]) + c11*f[:,1]\nsd_interp = c0*(1-f[:,2]) + c1*f[:,2]\n\nerr = np.abs(sd_interp - sd_true)\nprint(\"Trilinear SDF error quantiles (mm):\", np.quantile(err * 1000, [0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 1.0]), flush=True)\n\nsdf_i16 = np.clip(np.round(sdf * 10000.0), -32767, 32767).astype(np.int16)\n\n# Extract medial spheres along centerline (sdf < -0.095 m)\nmed_ijk = np.argwhere(sdf < -0.095)\nmed_xyz_a = grid_min + med_ijk * dx\nmed_r_a = -sdf[med_ijk[:, 0], med_ijk[:, 1], med_ijk[:, 2]]\norder = np.argsort(-med_r_a)\nkept_c = []\nkept_r = []\nfor idx in order:\n    c = med_xyz_a[idx]\n    if len(kept_c) == 0 or np.min(np.linalg.norm(np.array(kept_c) - c, axis=1)) > 0.025:\n        kept_c.append(c)\n        kept_r.append(med_r_a[idx])\nkept_c = np.array(kept_c, dtype=np.float64)\nkept_r = np.array(kept_r, dtype=np.float32)\nkept_c_b_local = ((kept_c @ R_a_to_b.T + t_a_to_b) - pos_b0).astype(np.float32)\ndel sdf\ngc.collect()\n\nb_full_local = ((sealed_a.astype(np.float64) @ R_a_to_b.T + t_a_to_b) - pos_b0).astype(np.float32)\nb_coarse = voxel_ds(b_full_local, 0.025)\nb_med = voxel_ds(b_full_local, 0.010)\nb_fine = voxel_ds(b_full_local, 0.0045)\n\nprint(f\"Medial spheres: {len(kept_c)}, radii min={kept_r.min()*1000:.1f}mm max={kept_r.max()*1000:.1f}mm\", flush=True)\nprint(f\"Surface clouds b_local: coarse={len(b_coarse)}, med={len(b_med)}, fine={len(b_fine)}\", flush=True)\n\nwith open(\"/app/planner_data.bin\", \"wb\") as f_out:\n    np.array(shape, dtype=np.int32).tofile(f_out)\n    np.array([dx], dtype=np.float64).tofile(f_out)\n    grid_min.astype(np.float64).tofile(f_out)\n    bbox_min.astype(np.float64).tofile(f_out)\n    bbox_max.astype(np.float64).tofile(f_out)\n    pos_b0.astype(np.float64).tofile(f_out)\n    counts = np.array([len(kept_c_b_local), len(b_coarse), len(b_med), len(b_fine)], dtype=np.int32)\n    counts.tofile(f_out)\n    kept_c_b_local.astype(np.float32).tofile(f_out)\n    kept_r.astype(np.float32).tofile(f_out)\n    b_coarse.astype(np.float32).tofile(f_out)\n    b_med.astype(np.float32).tofile(f_out)\n    b_fine.astype(np.float32).tofile(f_out)\n    sdf_i16.tofile(f_out)\n\nprint(\"Saved /app/planner_data.bin successfully!\", flush=True)\n","filePath":"/app/seal_and_build_sdf.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/seal_and_build_sdf.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/seal_and_build_sdf.py","time":{"start":1794649375160,"end":1794649375194}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d97041ae001y1Qtotm0reZ5FJ","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d96f8bb90015OCiRXkTD5MZeW"}}

f) != (size_t)counts[3]) std::exit(1);\n\n        size_t total_vox = (size_t)nx * ny * nz;\n        sdf_i16.resize(total_vox);\n        if (std::fread(sdf_i16.data(), sizeof(int16_t), total_vox, f) != total_vox) std::exit(1);\n        std::fclose(f);\n\n        max_local_radius = 0.0f;\n        b_local_min = {1e9f, 1e9f, 1e9f};\n        b_local_max = {-1e9f, -1e9f, -1e9f};\n        for (const auto& p : b_fine) {\n            float r = std::sqrt(p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y + p.z * p.z);\n            if (r > max_local_radius) max_local_radius = r;\n            b_local_min.x = std::min(b_local_min.x, p.x);\n            b_local_min.y = std::min(b_local_min.y, p.y);\n            b_local_min.z = std::min(b_local_min.z, p.z);\n            b_local_max.x = std::max(b_local_max.x, p.x);\n            b_local_max.y = std::max(b_local_max.y, p.y);\n            b_local_max.z = std::max(b_local_max.z, p.z);\n        }\n\n        bvh.reserve(b_fine.size() / 16);\n        build_bvh(0, (int)b_fine.size());\n        std::printf(\"Loaded WorldModel: grid=(%d,%d,%d), fine=%zu, bvh_nodes=%zu, max_r=%.3fm\\n\",\n                    nx, ny, nz, b_fine.size(), bvh.size(), max_local_radius);\n    }\n\n    int build_bvh(int start, int count) {\n        int node_idx = (int)bvh.size();\n        bvh.push_back({});\n        Vec3f mn{1e9f, 1e9f, 1e9f}, mx{-1e9f, -1e9f, -1e9f};\n        for (int i = start; i < start + count; ++i) {\n            const auto& p = b_fine[i];\n            if (p.x < mn.x) mn.x = p.x;\n            if (p.y < mn.y) mn.y = p.y;\n            if (p.z < mn.z) mn.z = p.z;\n            if (p.x > mx.x) mx.x = p.x;\n            if (p.y > mx.y) mx.y = p.y;\n            if (p.z > mx.z) mx.z = p.z;\n        }\n        Vec3f center{0.5f * (mn.x + mx.x), 0.5f * (mn.y + mx.y), 0.5f * (mn.z + mx.z)};\n        float r2 = 0.0f;\n        for (int i = start; i < start + count; ++i) {\n            float dx_ = b_fine[i].x - center.x;\n            float dy_ = b_fine[i].y - center.y;\n            float dz_ = b_fine[i].z - center.z;\n            float d2 = dx_ * dx_ + dy_ * dy_ + dz_ * dz_;\n            if (d2 > r2) r2 = d2;\n        }\n        bvh[node_idx].center = center;\n        bvh[node_idx].radius = std::sqrt(r2);\n        bvh[node_idx].start = start;\n        bvh[node_idx].count = count;\n\n        if (count <= 48) {\n            bvh[node_idx].left = -1;\n            bvh[node_idx].right = -1;\n            return node_idx;\n        }\n\n        float sx = mx.x - mn.x, sy = mx.y - mn.y, sz = mx.z - mn.z;\n        int axis = (sx >= sy && sx >= sz) ? 0 : ((sy >= sz) ? 1 : 2);\n        int mid = start + count / 2;\n        std::nth_element(b_fine.begin() + start, b_fine.begin() + mid, b_fine.begin() + start + count,\n (a.x < b.x) : ((axis == 1) ? (a.y < b.y) : (a.z < b.z));\n                         });\n        int left = build_bvh(start, mid - start);\n        int right = build_bvh(mid, start + count - mid);\n        bvh[node_idx].left = left;\n        bvh[node_idx].right = right;\n        return node_idx;\n    }\n\n    inline float query_sdf(const Vec3f& w) const {\n        if (w.x <= gmin_x || w.x >= gmax_x ||\n            w.y <= std::max(bmin_y - w.y, w.y - bmax_y));\n            float dz_ = std::max(0.0f, std::max(bmin_z - w.z, w.z - bmax_z));\n            return std::sqrt(dx_ * dx_ + dy_ * dy_ + dz_ * dz_);\n        }\n        float fx = (w.x - gmin_x) * inv_dx;\n        float fy = (w.y - gmin_y) * inv_dx;\n        float fz = (w.z - gmin_z) * inv_dx;\n        int i = (int)fx;\n        int j = (int)fy;\n        int k = (int)fz;\n        float tx = fx - i;\n        float ty = fy - j;\n        float tz = fz - k;\n\n        size_t s_y = (size_t)nz;\n        size_t s_x = (size_t)ny * nz;\n        size_t base = (size_t)i * s_x + (size_t)j * s_y + (size_t)k;\n\n        float c000 = sdf_i16[base];\n        float c001 = sdf_i16[base + 1];\n        float c010 = sdf_i16[base + s_y];\n        float c011 = sdf_i16[base + s_y + 1];\n        float c100 = sdf_i16[base + s_x];\n        float c101 = sdf_i16[base + s_x + 1];\n        float c110 = sdf_i16[base + s_x + s_y];\n        float c111 = sdf_i16[base + s_x + s_y + 1];\n\n        float c00 = c000 + tx * (c100 - c000);\n        float c01 = c001 + tx * (c101 - c001);\n        float c10 = c010 + tx * (c110 - c010);\n        float c11 = c011 + tx * (c111 - c011);\n        float c0 = c00 + ty * (c10 - c00);\n        float c1 = c01 + ty * (c11 - c01);\n        return (c0 + tz * (c1 - c0)) * 0.0001f;\n    }\n\n    inline Vec3f query_sdf_grad(const Vec3f& w) const {\n        const float eps = 0.005f;\n        float gx = query_sdf({w.x + eps, w.y, w.z}) - query_sdf({w.x - eps, w.y, w.z});\n        float gy = query_sdf({w.x, w.y + eps, w.z}) - query_sdf({w.x, w.y - eps, w.z});\n        float gz = query_sdf({w.x, w.y, w.z + eps}) - query_sdf({w.x, w.y, w.z - eps});\n        float n = std::sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy + gz * gz);\n        if (n < 1e-8f) return {0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f};\n        return {gx / n, gy / n, gz / n};\n    }\n\n    // Exact clearance over all 224,910 fine surface points using BVH + medial early reject!\n    // Stops early as soon as clearance < stop_below.\n    float clearance_exact(const Pose& pose, float stop_below, float max_cap = 0.50f, int* closest_fine_idx = nullptr) const {\n        if (pose.p.x < -0.75 || pose.p.x > 3.15 ||\n            pose.p.y < -0.75 || pose.p.y > 3.15 ||\n            pose.p.z < -0.75 || pose.p.z > 3.15) {\n            return -1.0f;\n        }\n        Mat3f T = Mat3f::from_pose(pose);\n\n        // Quick bounding sphere check around tube_b\n        float d_root = query_sdf(T.apply(bvh[0].center)) - bvh[0].radius - 0.002f;\n        if (d_root >= max_cap) return d_root;\n\n        // Stage 0: 159 medial interior spheres for ultra-fast collision reject\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < med_c.size(); ++i) {\n            float d = query_sdf(T.apply(med_c[i])) - (med_r[i] - 0.002f);\n            if (d < stop_below) return d;\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1: BVH branch-and-bound\n        float best = max_cap;\n        int best_idx = 0;\n        int stack[64];\n        float stack_lb[64];\n        int sp = 0;\n\n        stack[sp] = 0;\n        stack_lb[sp] = d_root;\n        sp++;\n\n        while (sp > 0) {\n            --sp;\n            if (stack_lb[sp] >= best) continue;\n            int u = stack[sp];\n            const BVHNode& node = bvh[u];\n            if (node.left < 0) {\n                int end = node.start + node.count;\n                for (int i = node.start; i < end; ++i) {\n            }\n            } else {\n                const BVHNode& L = bvh[node.left];\n                const BVHNode& R = bvh[node.right];\n                float lbL = query_sdf(T.apply(L.center)) - L.radius - 0.0018f;\n                float lbR = query_sdf(T.apply(R.center)) - R.radius - 0.0018f;\n                // Push larger lb first so smaller lb is popped first!\n                if (lbL < lbR) {\n                    if (lbR < best) { stack[sp] = node.right; stack_lb[sp++] = lbR; }\n                    if (lbL < best) { stack[sp] = node.left;  stack_lb[sp++] = lbL; }\n                } else {\n                    if (lbL < best) { stack[sp] = node.left;  stack_lb[sp++] = lbL; }\n                    if (lbR < best) { stack[sp] = node.right; stack_lb[sp++] = lbR; }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if (closest_fine_idx) *closest_fine_idx = best_idx;\n        return best;\n    }\n\n    // Coarse clearance on 8032 points + gradient push for sample retraction!\n    bool retract_pose(Pose& pose, float target_clear, int max_iters = 10) const {\n        for (int it = 0; it < max_iters; ++it) {\n            if (pose.p.x < -0.72 || pose.p.x > 3.12 ||\n     Vec3d f_sum{0, 0, 0}, tau_sum{0, 0, 0};\n            int n_active = 0;\n            // Check coarse surface points\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < b_coarse.size(); i += 2) {\n                Vec3f w = T.apply(b_coarse[i]);\n                float d = query_sdf(w);\n                if (d < min_d) min_d = d;\n                if (d < target_clear + 0.015f) {\n                    Vec3f g = query_sdf_grad(w);\n                    Vec3f r = T.rotate_only(b_coarse[i]);\n                    double wgt = (target_clear + 0.020 - d);\n                    Vec3d gd{g.x, g.y, g.z};\n return true;\n                // Push out exact closest point\n                int idx = 0;\n                ex = clearance_exact(pose, -10.0f, 0.20f, &idx);\n                Vec3f w = T.apply(b_fine[idx]);\n                Vec3f g = query_sdf_grad(w);\n                Vec3f r = T.rotate_only(b_fine[idx]);\n                double push = (target_clear - ex) + 0.004;\n                pose.p = pose.p + Vec3d{g.x, g.y, g.z} * push;\n                Vec3d tau = Vec3d{r.x, r.y, r.z}.cross(Vec3d{g.x, g.y, g.z});\n                if (tau.norm() > 1e-6) {\n                    pose.q = < -0.06f || n_active == 0) return false;\n            double fn = f_sum.norm();\n            double tn = tau_sum.norm();\n            double need = (target_clear - min_d) + 0.005;\n            if (fn slide to infinity along SOME straight line direction with clearance >= min_ray_clear!\n    bool check_ray_escape(const Pose& pose, float min_ray_clear, Vec3d* best_dir = nullptr, float* best_ray_clear = nullptr) const {\n        // Generate 160 Fibonacci directions + 6 cardinal directions\n        static std::vector<Vec3d> dirs;\n        static std::once_flag flag;\n        std::call_once(flag, []() {\n            dirs.push_back({0, 0, 1});\n            dirs.push_back({0, 0, -1});\n            dirs.push_back({1, 0, 0});\n            dirs.push_back({-1, 0, 0});\n            dirs.push_back({0, true;\n            // Max translation needed before bounding spheres separate completely (~4.5m)\n            while (tau < 4.5) {\n                double step = std::max(0.015, 0.85 * if (c < ray_min) ray_min = c;\n            }\n            if (ok) {\n                if (!best_dir) return true;\n                if (ray_min > best_c) {\n                    best_c = ray_min;\n                    best_u = u;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if (best_c >= min_ray_clear) {\n            if (best_dir) *best_dir = best_u;\n            if (best_ray_clear) *best_ray_clear = best_c;\n            return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    float max_ray_bvh_clearance(const Mat3f& T, float stop_below) const {\n        float d_root = query_sdf(T.apply(med_c[i])) - (med_r[i] - 0.002f);\n            if (d < stop_below) return d;\n        }\n        float best = 0.35f;\n        int stack[64];\n        float stack_lb[64];\n        int sp = 0;\n        stack[sp] = 0; stack_lb[sp++] = d_root;\n        while (sp > 0) {\n            --sp;\n            if (stack_lb[sp] >= best) continue;\n            const BVHNode& node = bvh[stack[sp]];\n            if (node.left < 0) {\n                int end = node.start + node.count;\n                for (int i = node.start; i < end; ++i) {\n                    float d = query_sdf(T.apply(b_fine[i]));\n                    if (d < best) {\n                        best = d;\n                        if (best < stop_below) return best;\n                    }\n - 0.0018f;\n                float lbR = query_sdf(T.apply(R.center)) - R.radius - 0.0018f;\n                if (lbL < lbR) {\n                    if (lbR < best) { stack[sp] = node.right; continuous edge under BOTH synchronized interpolation AND independent speed-limited interpolation!\n    bool edge_valid(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, float min_clear, bool check_both_laws = false, n_steps;\n            Pose mid{a.p + (b.p - a.p) * s, quat_slerp(a.q, b.q, s)};\n            float c = clearance_exact(mid, min_clear);\n            if (c < min_clear) return false;\n            if (c < worst) worst = c;\n        }\n        if (check_both_laws && dp > 1e-6 && da > 1e-6) {\n            // Independent speed law: v_lin = 0.1 m/s, v_ang = 0.1 rad/s\n            double T_lin = dp / 0.1;\n            double T_ang = da / 0.1;\n            double T_tot = std::max(T_lin, T_ang);\n            for (int i = 1; i < n_steps; ++i) {\n                double t = (T_tot * i) / n_steps;\n none), sets reached=true if connected!\nint extend_tree(const WorldModel& wm, std::vector<RRTNode>& tree, const Pose& target,\n                float min_clear, double step_size, bool allow_slide, bool& reached, int max_steps = 80) {\n    reached = false;\n    int cur_idx = nearest_node(tree, target);\n    int added_idx = -1;\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < max_steps; ++step) {\n        const Pose& cur = tree[cur_idx].pose;\n        double d = pose_dist(cur, target);\n        if (d < 1e-6) { reached = true; return cur_idx; }\n        double t = std::min(1.0, step_size / d);\n        Pose next = pose_interp(cur, target, t);\n\n        if (wm.edge_valid(cur, next, min_clear)) {\n            cur_idx = (int)tree.size();\n            tree.push_back({next, (added_idx == -1) ? nearest_node(tree, cur) : added_idx});\n            // Wait: fix parent carefully! `cur_idx` before push was the exact parent!\n            tree.back().parent = cur_idx - 0; // wait, let's write parent cleanly below!\n            added_idx = cur_idx;\n            if (t >= 1.0 - 1e-9) { reached = true; return cur_idx; }\n        } else if (allow_slide && step < 12) {\n            // Try clearance retraction on `next` so tree slides along narrow curved channel!\n            Pose slid = next;\n            if (wm.retract_pose(slid, min_clear + 0.002f, 5) &&\n                pose_dist(cur, slid) <= step_size * 1.8 &&\n                pose_dist(slid, target) < d - 0.005 &&\n                wm.edge_valid(cur, slid, min_clear)) {\n                int p_idx = cur_idx;\n                cur_idx = (int)tree.size();\n                tree.push_back({slid, p_idx});\n                added_idx = cur_idx;\n            } else {\n                break;\n            }\n        } else {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    return added_idx;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    float target_clear = (argc > 1) ? std::atof(argv[1]) : 0.008f;\n    WorldModel wm;\n    wm.load(\"/app/planner_data.bin\");\n\n    Pose q_start{wm.pos_b0, {1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0}};\n    int cidx = 0;\n    float start_clear = wm.clearance_exact(q_start, -1.0f, 0.50f, &cidx);\n    std::printf(\"Initial pose clearance: %.3f mm\\n\", start_clear * 1000.0f);\n\n    // Benchmark 10,000 random clearance queries\n    {\n        std::mt19937 rng(123);\n        std::uniform_real_distribution<double> up(-0.4, 2.5);\n        std::normal_distribution<double> uq(0.0, 1.0);\n        auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        int free_cnt = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) {\n            Quat q{uq(rng), uq(rng), uq(rng), uq(rng)};\n            q.normalize();\n            Pose p{{up(rng), up(rng), up(rng)}, q};\n            if (wm.clearance_exact(p, target_clear) >= target_clear) free_cnt++;\n        }\n        auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        double ms = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(t1 - t0).count();\n        std::printf(\"10,000 exact BVH queries in %.2f ms (%.0f queries/sec/thread), free=%d\\n\",\n                    ms, 10000.0 / (ms * 1e-3), free_cnt);\n    }\n\n best_u = u; }\n            }\n        }\n        if (best_c >= min_ray_clear) {\n            if (best_dir) *best_dir = best_u;\n            if (best_ray_clear) *best_ray_clear = best_c;\n            return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\nstd::vector<Pose> load_plan_json(const char* path) {\n    std::ifstream ifs(path);\n    std::string line;\n    std::vector<Pose> res;\n    while (std::getline(ifs, line)) {\n        auto p_pos = line.find(\"\\\"pos\\\": [\");\n        if (p_pos == std::string::npos) continue;\n        Pose wp;\n        const char* s = line.c_str() + p_pos;\n        if (std::sscanf(s, \"\\\"pos\\\": [%lf, %lf, %lf], \\\"quat\\\": [%lf, %lf, %lf, %lf]\",\n                        &wp.p.x, &wp.p.y, &wp.p.z, &wp.q.w, &wp.q.x, &wp.q.y, &wp.q.z) == 7) {\n            wp.q.normalize();\n            res.push_back(wp);\n        }\n    }\n    return res;\n}\n\nint main() {\n    WorldModel wm;\n    wm.load(\"/app/planner_data.bin\");\n    auto init_wps = load_plan_json(\"/app/solution_plan.json\");\n    std::printf(\"Loaded %zu initial waypoints\\n\", init_wps.size());\n\n    // Resample evenly at step ~0.04 in SE(3)\n    auto resample = [](const std::vector<Pose>& src, double ds) {\n        std::vector<Pose> out;\n        out.push_back(src[0]);\n        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < src.size(); ++i) {\n            double d = pose_dist(src[i], src[i + 1]);\n            int n = std::max(1, (int)std::ceil(d / ds));\n            for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) out.push_back(pose_interp(src[i], src[i + 1], (double)k / n));\n        }\n        return out;\n    };\n\n    std::vector<Pose> path = resample(init_wps, 0.035);\n    std::printf(\"Resampled to %zu waypoints for Chebyshev max-min clearance optimization...\\n\", path.size());\n\n    std::mt19937 rng(12345);\n    std::normal_distribution<double> gauss(0.0, 1.0);\n\n    double scales_p[] = {0.015, 0.008, 0.004, 0.002, 0.001};\n    double scales_q[] = {0.025, 0.014, 0.007, 0.0035, 0.0015};\n\n    for (int stage = 0; stage < 5; ++stage) {\n        double sp = scales_p[stage], sq = scales_q[stage];\n        for (int pass = 0; pass < 18; ++pass) {\n            for (size_t i = 1; i + 1 < path.size(); ++i) {\n                float c1 = 0, c2 = 0;\n                wm.edge_clear(path[i - 1], path[i], -1.0f, false, c1, 0.008);\n                wm.edge_clear(path[i], path[i + 1], -1.0f, false, c2, 0.008);\n                float cur_min = std::min(c1, c2);\n\n                // First try pulling slightly toward geodesic midpoint if clearance stays high (>= 25mm or > cur_min)\n                Pose mid = pose_interp(path[i - 1], path[i + 1], 0.5);\n                Pose smooth_cand = pose_interp(path[i], mid, 0.25);\n                float sc1 = 0, sc2 = 0;\n                float req_smooth = std::min(0.025f, cur_min);\n                if (wm.edge_clear(path[i - 1], smooth_cand, req_smooth, false, sc1, 0.008) &&\n                    wm.edge_clear(smooth_cand, path[i + 1], req_smooth, false, sc2, 0.008)) {\n                    path[i] = smooth_cand;\n                    cur_min = std::min(sc1, sc2);\n                }\n\n                // If cur_min < 28mm, run Chebyshev hill-climbing!\n                if (cur_min < 0.028f) {\n                    for (int trial = 0; trial < 12; ++trial) {\n                        Pose cand;\n                        cand.p = {path[i].p.x + gauss(rng) * sp,\n                                  path[i].p.y + gauss(rng) * sp,\n                                  path[i].p.z + gauss(rng) * sp};\n                        Vec3d rv{gauss(rng) * sq, gauss(rng) * sq, gauss(rng) * sq};\n                        cand.q = quat_from_rotvec(rv) * path[i].q;\n                        cand.q.normalize();\n                        if (pose_dist(path[i - 1], cand) > 0.12 || pose_dist(cand, path[i + 1]) > 0.12) continue;\n                        float nc1 = 0, nc2 = 0;\n                        if (wm.edge_clear(path[i - 1], cand, cur_min + 0.00005f, false, nc1, 0.008) &&\n                            wm.edge_clear(cand, path[i + 1], cur_min + 0.00005f, false, nc2, 0.008)) {\n                            path[i] = cand;\n                            cur_min = std::min(nc1, nc2);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        float bottleneck = 1e9f;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < path.size(); ++i) {\n            float ec = 0;\n            wm.edge_clear(path[i], path[i + 1], -1.0f, false, ec, 0.004);\n            bottleneck = std::min(bottleneck, ec);\n        }\n        std::printf(\"Stage %d (sp=%.1fmm): continuous bottleneck clearance = %.3f mm\\n\",\n                    stage, sp * 1000.0, bottleneck * 1000.0f);\n    }\n\n    // Trim at earliest pose where ray-escape holds with >= 25 mm ray clearance, then add ONE 8cm step along escape ray!\n    size_t esc_idx = path.size() - 1;\n    Vec3d esc_u{0, 0, 1};\n    float esc_rc = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 1; i < path.size(); ++i) {\n        Vec3d u; float rc = 0;\n        if (wm.check_ray_escape(path[i], 0.025f, &u, &rc)) {\n            esc_idx = i; esc_u = u; esc_rc = rc; break;\n        }\n    }\n    path.resize(esc_idx + 1);\n    Pose extra = path.back();\n    extra.p = extra.p + esc_u * 0.085;\n    float dummy_ec = 0;\n    if (wm.in_workspace(extra) && wm.edge_clear(path.back(), extra, 0.020f, true, dummy_ec, 0.004)) {\n        path.push_back(extra);\n    }\n    std::printf(\"Trimmed at ray-escape index %zu (+1 insurance step), ray_clear=%.2f mm along (%.3f, %.3f, %.3f)\\n\",\n                esc_idx, esc_rc * 1000.0f, esc_u.x, esc_u.y, esc_u.z);\n\n    // Resample finely (every ~0.015 in SE(3)) for Global Shortest-Path DAG Dynamic Programming!\n    std::vector<Pose> dag_pts = resample(path, 0.015);\n    size_t N = dag_pts.size();\n    std::printf(\"Running Global DAG Shortest-Path DP on %zu dense curve nodes...\\n\", N);\n\n    // Compute bottleneck along dag_pts\n    float curve_min_clear = 1e9f;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < N; ++i) {\n        float ec = 0;\n        wm.edge_clear(dag_pts[i], dag_pts[i + 1], -1.0f, true, ec, 0.003);\n        curve_min_clear = std::min(curve_min_clear, ec);\n    }\n    std::printf(\"Dense curve exact min clearance (both laws, 3mm step): %.3f mm\\n\", curve_min_clear * 1000.0f);\n\n    // Try high clearance floor first (e.g. min(12mm, curve_min_clear - 0.8mm))!\n    float dp_floor = std::max(0.004f, curve_min_clear - 0.0008f);\n    const double MAX_DP = 0.095;\n    const double MAX_DA = 0.190;\n\n    std::vector<int> dist(N, 1000000);\n    std::vector<float> best_min_c(N, -1.0f);\n    std::vector<int> parent(N, -1);\n    dist[0] = 0;\n    best_min_c[0] = 1.0f;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        if (dist[i] >= 1000000) continue;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < N; ++j) {\n            double dp = (dag_pts[j].p - dag_pts[i].p).norm();\n            double da = quat_angle_dist(dag_pts[i].q, dag_pts[j].q);\n            if (dp > MAX_DP || da > MAX_DA) {\n                // Note: curve might bend slightly so keep checking a few more j, break if way past\n                if (dp > MAX_DP * 1.4 || da > MAX_DA * 1.4) break;\n                continue;\n            }\n            if (dist[i] + 1 > dist[j]) continue;\n            // Require higher clearance in wide regions (at least min(15mm, dp_floor_local)), and >= dp_floor everywhere!\n            float req = dp_floor;\n            float ec = 0;\n            if (!wm.edge_clear(dag_pts[i], dag_pts[j], req, true, ec, 0.003)) continue;\n            // Also prefer edges that don't unnecessarily skim below 14mm when original curve was > 18mm\n            float path_mc = std::min(best_min_c[i], ec);\n            if (dist[i] + 1 < dist[j] || (dist[i] + 1 == dist[j] && path_mc > best_min_c[j])) {\n                dist[j] = dist[i] + 1;\n                best_min_c[j] = path_mc;\n                parent[j] = (int)i;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<Pose> opt_actions;\n    for (int cur = (int)N - 1; cur != -1; cur = parent[cur]) opt_actions.push_back(dag_pts[cur]);\n    std::reverse(opt_actions.begin(), opt_actions.end());\n\n    // Also do 10 passes of Chebyshev hill-climbing directly on `opt_actions` under BOTH velocity laws!\n    for (int stage = 0; stage < 3; ++stage) {\n        double sp = 0.005 * std::pow(0.4, stage);\n        double sq = 0.008 * std::pow(0.4, stage);\n        for (int pass = 0; pass < 20; ++pass) {\n            for (size_t i = 1; i + 1 < opt_actions.size(); ++i) {\n                float c1 = 0, c2 = 0;\n                wm.edge_clear(opt_actions[i - 1], opt_actions[i], -1.0f, true, c1, 0.003);\n                wm.edge_clear(opt_actions[i], opt_actions[i + 1], -1.0f, true, c2, 0.003);\n                float cur_min = std::min(c1, c2);\n                if (cur_min >= 0.030f) continue;\n                for (int tr = 0; tr < 15; ++tr) {\n                    Pose cand;\n                    cand.p = {opt_actions[i].p.x + gauss(rng) * sp,\n                              opt_actions[i].p.y + gauss(rng) * sp,\n                              opt_actions[i].p.z + gauss(rng) * sp};\n                    Vec3d rv{gauss(rng) * sq, gauss(rng) * sq, gauss(rng) * sq};\n                    cand.q = quat_from_rotvec(rv) * opt_actions[i].q;\n                    cand.q.normalize();\n                    if ((cand.p - opt_actions[i - 1].p).norm() > MAX_DP ||\n                        quat_angle_dist(opt_actions[i - 1].q, cand.q) > MAX_DA ||\n                        (opt_actions[i + 1].p - cand.p).norm() > MAX_DP ||\n                        quat_angle_dist(cand.q, opt_actions[i + 1].q) > MAX_DA) continue;\n                    float nc1 = 0, nc2 = 0;\n                    if (wm.edge_clear(opt_actions[i - 1], cand, cur_min + 0.00005f, true, nc1, 0.003) &&\n                        wm.edge_clear(cand, opt_actions[i + 1], cur_min + 0.00005f, true, nc2, 0.003)) {\n                        opt_actions[i] = cand;\n                        cur_min = std::min(nc1, nc2);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    float global_min_c = 1e9f;\n    int worst_step = -1;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < opt_actions.size(); ++i) {\n        float ec = 0;\n        wm.edge_clear(opt_actions[i], opt_actions[i + 1], -1.0f, true, ec, 0.0025);\n        if (ec < global_min_c) { global_min_c = ec; worst_step = (int)i; }\n    }\n    Vec3d final_u{0, 0, 1}; float final_rc = 0;\n    bool final_esc = wm.check_ray_escape(opt_actions.back(), 0.020f, &final_u, &final_rc);\n\n    std::printf(\"\\n=== GLOBALLY OPTIMIZED ACTION PLAN ===\\n\");\n    std::printf(\"Move actions: %zu (+ 1 grab = %zu / 198 -> projected score = %.4f)\\n\",\n                opt_actions.size() - 1, opt_actions.size(), 1.0 - 0.5 * (opt_actions.size() / 198.0));\n    std::printf(\"Global minimum clearance (both laws, 2.5mm substeps, 225k pts): %.3f mm (at step %d)\\n\",\n                global_min_c * 1000.0f, worst_step);\n    std::printf(\"Final pose ray-escape: %s, dir=(%.3f, %.3f, %.3f), ray_clear=%.2f mm\\n\",\n                final_esc ? \"YES\" : \"NO\", final_u.x, final_u.y, final_u.z, final_rc * 1000.0f);\n\n    FILE* jf = std::fopen(\"/app/optimized_plan.json\", \"w\");\n    std::fprintf(jf, \"{\\n  \\\"min_clearance_m\\\": %.6f,\\n  \\\"escape_dir\\\": [%.6f, %.6f, %.6f],\\n  \\\"waypoints\\\": [\\n\",\n                 global_min_c, final_u.x, final_u.y, final_u.z);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < opt_actions.size(); ++i) {\n        const auto& wp = opt_actions[i];\n        float c = wm.clearance_exact(wp, -1.0f);\n        bool esc = wm.check_ray_escape(wp, 0.015f);\n        std::fprintf(jf, \"    {\\\"pos\\\": [%.7f, %.7f, %.7f], \\\"quat\\\": [%.7f, %.7f, %.7f, %.7f], \\\"clear_m\\\": %.6f, \\\"ray_escape\\\": %s}%s\\n\",\n                     wp.p.x, wp.p.y, wp.p.z, wp.q.w, wp.q.x, wp.q.y, wp.q.z, c,\n                     esc ? \"true\" : \"false\", (i + 1 < opt_actions.size()) ? \",\" : \"\");\n    }\n    std::fprintf(jf, \"  ]\\n}\\n\");\n    std::fclose(jf);\n    return 0;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/optimize_path.cpp","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/optimize_path.cpp","time":{"start":1794650276440,"end":1794650276462}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d97e024900112lez4QEF5DYY7","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d97c753b001KyqjzA3D5S3SFU"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794650835472,"sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"nd0eTBvEH1SO9tjp","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import json\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation, Slerp\n\nprint(\"Loading raw camera point clouds...\", flush=True)\nclouds = np.load(\"/app/tubes_cloud.npz\")\npts_a = clouds[\"pts_a\"]\npts_b = clouds[\"pts_b\"]\n\ndef voxel_ds(pts, vs):\n    mn = pts.min(axis=0)\n    c = np.floor((pts - mn) / vs).astype(np.int64)\n    keys = c[:, 0] * 100000000 + c[:, 1] * 10000 + c[:, 2]\n    _, idx = np.unique(keys, return_index=True)\n    return pts[idx]\n\na4 = voxel_ds(pts_a, 0.004)\nb5 = voxel_ds(pts_b, 0.005)\npos_b0 = np.array([1.2, 0.36, 0.28], dtype=np.float64)\nb5_local = b5 - pos_b0\ntree_a = cKDTree(a4)\n\nwith open(\"/app/optimized_plan.json\") as f:\n    plan = json.load(f)\n\nwps = plan[\"waypoints\"]\nprint(f\"Verifying {len(wps)-1} move steps across {len(a4)} raw pts_a and {len(b5_local)} raw pts_b...\", flush=True)\n\ndef wxyz_to_rot(q):\n    # scipy uses xyzw\n    return Rotation.from_quat([q[1], q[2], q[3], q[0]])\n\nmin_sync = 1e9\nmin_indep = 1e9\nworst_sync_step = -1\nworst_indep_step = -1\nmax_dp = 0.0\nmax_da = 0.0\n\nfor i in range(len(wps) - 1):\n    p0 = np.array(wps[i][\"pos\"])\n    p1 = np.array(wps[i + 1][\"pos\"])\n    r0 = wxyz_to_rot(wps[i][\"quat\"])\n    r1 = wxyz_to_rot(wps[i + 1][\"quat\"])\n\n    dp = np.linalg.norm(p1 - p0)\n    da = (r0.inv() * r1).magnitude()\n    max_dp = max(max_dp, dp)\n    max_da = max(max_da, da)\n    assert dp <= 0.0999, f\"Step {i} dp={dp} > 0.1\"\n    assert da <= 0.1999, f\"Step {i} da={da} > 0.2\"\n    assert np.all(p1 >= -0.79) and np.all(p1 <= 3.19), f\"Step {i} out of workspace: {p1}\"\n\n    slerp = Slerp([0.0, 1.0], Rotation.concatenate([r0, r1]))\n    # Check 12 substeps synchronized\n    ts = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 13)\n    rots = slerp(ts)\n    for k, s in enumerate(ts):\n        p = p0 + s * (p1 - p0)\n        pts_w = b5_local @ rots[k].as_matrix().T + p\n        d, _ = tree_a.query(pts_w, k=1, workers=-1)\n        md = d.min()\n        if md < min_sync:\n            min_sync = md\n            worst_sync_step = i\n\n    # Check 12 substeps independent speed (0.1 m/s, 0.1 rad/s)\n    if dp > 1e-6 and da > 1e-6:\n        T_lin = dp / 0.1\n        T_ang = da / 0.1\n        T_tot = max(T_lin, T_ang)\n        for k in range(1, 12):\n            t = T_tot * (k / 12.0)\n            s_lin = min(1.0, t / T_lin)\n            s_ang = min(1.0, t / T_ang)\n            p = p0 + s_lin * (p1 - p0)\n            rot = slerp([s_ang])[0]\n            pts_w = b5_local @ rot.as_matrix().T + p\n            d, _ = tree_a.query(pts_w, k=1, workers=-1)\n            md = d.min()\n            if md < min_indep:\n                min_indep = md\n                worst_indep_step = i\n\n# Also verify ray escape from final waypoint along plan[\"escape_dir\"]!\nu = np.array(plan[\"escape_dir\"], dtype=np.float64)\nu /= np.linalg.norm(u)\np_end = np.array(wps[-1][\"pos\"])\nr_end = wxyz_to_rot(wps[-1][\"quat\"])\nb_end = b5_local @ r_end.as_matrix().T + p_end\nray_min = 1e9\nfor tau in np.linspace(0.0, 4.0, 161):\n    d, _ = tree_a.query(b_end + tau * u, k=1, workers=-1)\n    ray_min = min(ray_min, d.min())\n\nprint(f\"Max step dp = {max_dp:.5f} m (limit 0.10), max da = {max_da:.5f} rad (limit 0.20)\")\nprint(f\"Independent raw point-cloud min clearance (SYNC law):  {min_sync*1000:.2f} mm (at step {worst_sync_step})\")\nprint(f\"Independent raw point-cloud min clearance (INDEP law): {min_indep*1000:.2f} mm (at step {worst_indep_step})\")\nprint(f\"Final waypoint ray-escape min clearance along {u.round(3)}: {ray_min*1000:.2f} mm\")\n","filePath":"/app/verify_plan.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/verify_plan.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/verify_plan.py","time":{"start":1794650835456,"end":1794650835470}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d98689f5001qj4bzB5jYI0xUH","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d9863491001KhLdpNS7LP0ejX"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794651300310,"sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"qftelZT1nqi8ZELm","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import json\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation\nfrom mcp_client import MCPClient\n\nwith open(\"/app/optimized_plan.json\") as f:\n    wps = json.load(f)[\"waypoints\"]\n\np0 = np.array(wps[0][\"pos\"])\nq0_wxyz = np.array(wps[0][\"quat\"])\np1 = np.array(wps[1][\"pos\"])\nq1_wxyz = np.array(wps[1][\"quat\"])\n\nr0 = Rotation.from_quat([q0_wxyz[1], q0_wxyz[2], q0_wxyz[3], q0_wxyz[0]])\nr1 = Rotation.from_quat([q1_wxyz[1], q1_wxyz[2], q1_wxyz[3], q1_wxyz[0]])\n\ndp = p1 - p0\n# In world frame: R1 = dR * R0 => dR = R1 * R0^-1\ndR = r1 * r0.inv()\nrv = dR.as_rotvec()\n\nclient = MCPClient()\nres = json.loads(client.call_tool(\"move\", {\n    \"handle\": 0,\n    \"dx\": float(dp[0]),\n    \"dy\": float(dp[1]),\n    \"dz\": float(dp[2]),\n    \"droll\": float(rv[0]),\n    \"dpitch\": float(rv[1]),\n    \"dyaw\": float(rv[2]),\n    \"frame\": \"world\",\n})[\"content\"][0][\"text\"])\nprint(\"MOVE 1 RESULT:\", json.dumps(res, indent=2))\n\nst = json.loads(client.call_tool(\"get_state\")[\"content\"][0][\"text\"])\nct = json.loads(client.call_tool(\"get_contacts\")[\"content\"][0][\"text\"])\nprint(\"STATE AFTER MOVE 1:\", json.dumps(st, indent=2))\nprint(\"CONTACTS AFTER MOVE 1:\", json.dumps(ct, indent=2))\n\n# Check which rotation convention matches handles[0][\"quat\"]!\nhq = st[\"handles\"][0][\"quat\"]\nr_actual = Rotation.from_quat([hq[1], hq[2], hq[3], hq[0]])\n\nfor name, r_cand in [\n    (\"rotvec\", Rotation.from_rotvec(rv)),\n    (\"extrinsic_xyz\", Rotation.from_euler(\"xyz\", rv)),\n    (\"intrinsic_XYZ\", Rotation.from_euler(\"XYZ\", rv)),\n    (\"extrinsic_zyx\", Rotation.from_euler(\"zyx\", rv[::-1])),\n]:\n    err_deg = (r_actual.inv() * r_cand).magnitude() * 180 / np.pi\n    print(f\"Convention {name:15s}: error = {err_deg:.6f} deg\")\n","filePath":"/app/test_step1.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/test_step1.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/test_step1.py","time":{"start":1794651300304,"end":1794651300308}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d98da1cd001EE2rWQ3nRVg6Fj","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d98d69b50018GpYBibTvpJZ5C"}}
