{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794651391872,"sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"XFEKzMWOazMcN8sR","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/app/execute_plan.py","content":"import json\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation, Slerp\nfrom mcp_client import MCPClient\n\nwith open(\"/app/optimized_plan.json\") as f:\n    plan = json.load(f)\n\nwps = plan[\"waypoints\"]\nescape_dir = np.array(plan[\"escape_dir\"], dtype=np.float64)\nescape_dir /= np.linalg.norm(escape_dir)\n\nclient = MCPClient()\n\ndef get_cur_pose():\n    st = json.loads(client.call_tool(\"get_state\")[\"content\"][0][\"text\"])\n    p = np.array(st[\"objects\"][\"tube_b\"][\"pos\"], dtype=np.float64)\n    q = st[\"objects\"][\"tube_b\"][\"quat\"]\n    r = Rotation.from_quat([q[1], q[2], q[3], q[0]])\n    return st, p, r\n\ndef step_toward(p_cur, r_cur, p_tgt, r_tgt, label):\n    dp = p_tgt - p_cur\n    dR = r_tgt * r_cur.inv()\n    euler = dR.as_euler(\"xyz\")\n    da = dR.magnitude()\n\n    # Split if close to step limits\n    n_sub = max(\n        1,\n        int(np.ceil(max(np.linalg.norm(dp) / 0.097, da / 0.194, np.linalg.norm(euler) / 0.194)))\n    )\n    slerp = Slerp([0.0, 1.0], Rotation.concatenate([r_cur, r_tgt]))\n\n    for sub in range(1, n_sub + 1):\n        s = sub / n_sub\n        p_sub = p_cur + s * (p_tgt - p_cur) if n_sub > 1 else p_tgt\n        r_sub = slerp([s])[0] if n_sub > 1 else r_tgt\n\n        _, pc, rc = get_cur_pose()\n        d_p = p_sub - pc\n        eul = (r_sub * rc.inv()).as_euler(\"xyz\")\n\n        res = json.loads(client.call_tool(\"move\", {\n            \"handle\": 0,\n            \"dx\": float(d_p[0]),\n            \"dy\": float(d_p[1]),\n            \"dz\": float(d_p[2]),\n            \"droll\": float(eul[0]),\n            \"dpitch\": float(eul[1]),\n            \"dyaw\": float(eul[2]),\n            \"frame\": \"world\",\n        })[\"content\"][0][\"text\"])\n\n        ct = json.loads(client.call_tool(\"get_contacts\")[\"content\"][0][\"text\"])\n        min_margin_mm = min([c[\"distance_m\"] * 1000.0 for c in ct[\"contacts\"]], default=999.0)\n        lag_mm = max([g[\"lag_m\"] * 1000.0 for g in ct.get(\"grip_lag\", [])], default=0.0)\n\n        print(\n            f\"[{label}] act={res['action']:3d} frac={res['requested_fraction_executed']:.3f} \"\n            f\"blocked={res['blocked']} viol={res['violations']} in_contact={ct['in_contact']} \"\n            f\"min_margin={min_margin_mm:6.2f}mm lag={lag_mm:.2f}mm clamp={res['clamped']} \"\n            f\"done={res['done']} SUCCESS={res['success']}\",\n            flush=True,\n        )\n\n        if res[\"done\"] or res[\"success\"]:\n            return res, True\n        if res[\"blocked\"] or res[\"violations\"] > 0 or ct[\"in_contact\"]:\n            print(\"!!! SAFETY STOP: blocked / violation / contact detected !!!\", flush=True)\n            return res, True\n\n    return res, False\n\n\ndef main():\n    st, p_cur, r_cur = get_cur_pose()\n    print(f\"Starting closed-loop execution at action={st['actions_used']}, pos={p_cur.round(4)}\", flush=True)\n\n    # Execute from waypoint 3 onwards (since wp 1 and wp 2 were already reached)\n    for idx in range(3, len(wps)):\n        st, p_cur, r_cur = get_cur_pose()\n        p_tgt = np.array(wps[idx][\"pos\"], dtype=np.float64)\n        q_tgt = wps[idx][\"quat\"]\n        r_tgt = Rotation.from_quat([q_tgt[1], q_tgt[2], q_tgt[3], q_tgt[0]])\n\n        res, stop = step_toward(p_cur, r_cur, p_tgt, r_tgt, f\"wp {idx:2d}/{len(wps)-1}\")\n        if stop:\n            break\n\n    st_final = json.loads(client.call_tool(\"get_state\")[\"content\"][0][\"text\"])\n    if not st_final[\"success\"] and not st_final[\"done\"]:\n        print(\"Reached final planned waypoint; sliding along escape_dir if needed...\", flush=True)\n        for extra in range(1, 15):\n            st, p_cur, r_cur = get_cur_pose()\n            p_tgt = np.clip(p_cur + escape_dir * 0.092, -0.75, 3.15)\n            res, stop = step_toward(p_cur, r_cur, p_tgt, r_cur, f\"esc {extra:2d}\")\n            if stop:\n                break\n\n    st_end = json.loads(client.call_tool(\"get_state\")[\"content\"][0][\"text\"])\n    print(\"\\nFINAL STATE:\", json.dumps(st_end, indent=2), flush=True)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/execute_plan.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/execute_plan.py","time":{"start":1794651391852,"end":1794651391867}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d98f07620016YMrqLS55MOnyt","sessionID":"ses_e26a0ebd9ffeNIb3u6Xit3gIv2","messageID":"msg_1d98e7f2a001d94Ab3u55If79C"}}
